findings.text: Provides a logical immediate encoding service that selects a base operation encoding from the requested logical type and then applies destination and source register fields plus a packed immediate; unknown operation types are reported through a fault sentinel rather than an encoding.

Encodability requires a non-zero value that is neither all ones within its element width nor wider than that width; the encoder narrows repeating patterns to their smallest power-of-two element size, derives rotation and run-length fields from the position and contiguity of set bits, sets the size flag only for the wider variant, and returns a fault sentinel for any pattern that cannot be represented.

Single-slot alternative patch point for a branch-history workaround: the rewrite applies only when the mitigation build option and the firmware-assistance state are both active, preserves the destination register decoded from the original slot, and materializes the workaround identifier as a logical immediate; when disabled or unencodable the site is left unchanged.

Two-slot alternative patch point for branch-history clearing: when instruction-based clearing is already available the original sequence is kept, otherwise both slots are neutralized with architectural no-operation encodings.

State-change notifier for unprivileged extended packet filter posture: it stays silent unless the global Spectre variant two state is non-vulnerable and the branch-history state is mitigated, and only then warns when the supplied new state value is clear.

Processor operations table published under the firmware interface name, wiring initialization, preparation and boot handlers unconditionally and adding disable-eligibility, disable, die and kill handlers only when hotplug is configured.

Boot path state machine: initialization always succeeds, preparation requires the firmware power-on capability and fails as unavailable hardware otherwise, and boot invokes firmware power-on with the logical identifier and the kernel secondary entry address, propagating permission denials quietly while logging other failures.

Hotplug teardown path: disable eligibility and disable both refuse when a trusted operating system is resident on the target, disable additionally requires the firmware power-off capability, die issues a power-down request with a default power state, and kill polls firmware affinity until the off state is observed within a short bounded interval, otherwise warning and reporting a timeout.
Compilation unit tags its diagnostic output with a subsystem-specific log prefix.
Compilation unit enables tracepoint definition at build time.

Register offset descriptor pairs a textual name with a byte offset; the lookup table covers the full general register file with an additional link-register alias for the last general register plus stack pointer, program counter and processor state entries, terminated by a null-named sentinel.
Name-to-offset query over the register table returning the stored byte offset on match and an invalid-argument failure when the name is unknown.

Kernel stack word accessor validates that the addressed word lies within the same stack granule as the traced stack pointer or on the interrupt stack before performing a single volatile read, returning zero for out-of-range positions.
Detach cleanup hook that disables single-step execution for the traced task.

Hardware breakpoint trap reporting distinguishes compatibility tasks, which receive a ptrace trap whose error value encodes the triggering breakpoint or watchpoint slot alongside the trigger address, from native tasks, which receive a hardware-breakpoint fault carrying the trigger address with a descriptive message.

Breakpoint slot lifecycle: per-task breakpoint and watchpoint slots are addressed by index with bounds checks against architectural maxima and speculation hardening, invalid note types are rejected, absent slots are lazily created as disabled defaults with type derived from the note kind, and stored events can be replaced.

Breakpoint attribute translation short-circuits disabled controls, otherwise converts architectural control fields into generic length, type and address offset, enforces execute-only types for breakpoints and access types for watchpoints, reads back decoded control and address with zero for empty slots, and packs monitor version with slot count into resource information.
Hardware debug register transfer uses eight byte address fields with four byte control fields and four byte pad fields per slot.

Register-set transfer for hardware debug state writes resource information followed by per-slot address, control and zero pad until the buffer is exhausted, while installation skips the resource header, requires a full address width per slot, applies address before control for each slot in order, ignores pad bytes, and fails on truncation or invalid attributes.

General register set transfer reads the full user register block and, on write, stages the incoming block, validates it, installs it on success, and then reconciles the saved first syscall argument with the possibly traced value.

Saved syscall argument coherence skips the update for the no-syscall marker, compatibility threads, missing stop information and syscall-exit stops, otherwise mirrors the current first argument into the saved original so dispatch, filtering and restart observe the traced value.

User register validation first clears single-step state then dispatches by thread personality: compatibility state requires unprivileged thirty-two bit mode with abort, interrupt and fast-interrupt unmasked and otherwise forces a valid thirty-two bit status preserving condition and flag fields, while native state requires unprivileged sixty-four bit mode with debug and masks cleared and otherwise forces a valid sixty-four bit status preserving condition codes.
Floating-point register set availability probe reporting the set size when the feature is present and a device-absent failure otherwise.

Alternative patch handlers enforce exact slot counts and abort on mismatch, and logical immediate construction can yield a fault encoding for unrepresentable values that callers must detect before installing.
Processor kill observation can race with the dying path, so bounded polling with a timeout is required, and trusted operating system residency vetoes disable to avoid denial by firmware.

User-supplied breakpoint indices and register-set extents are untrusted: indices are hardened and range-checked, short writes are rejected, and stack reads outside the validated range yield zero instead of faulting.
